facts.claim: The hunters divide the game so that the hunter receives a hind-quarter and the head, while the rest goes to the company.
facts.quote: the man who has killed the animal, receives a hind-quarter and the head, the rest belongs to the company.

facts.claim: The village holds a large hunt that repeats the village-hunt on a larger scale.
facts.quote: This day is followed by a great hunt of the whole Nddu, a repetition of the village-hunt, on a larger scale.

facts.claim: The Keilmiirta festival is considered the most glorious by young Coorgs.
facts.quote: The Keilmiirta, to the taste of young Coorg, is the most glorious of all the festivals.
